events.title: Playtest #2 is Officially LIVE! 👑
events.summary: Playtest #2 is officially LIVE on Steam! Whether you survived the first round or you’re fresh off the bench, it’s time to grab your squad, lock in, and get that slippery royal carcass moving again. We’ve been cooking up some sweet tweaks based on your feedback, and we need your goblin brains to test out the fresh polish. 🛠️ WHAT’S NEW IN PLAYTEST #2?Overhauled King Dragging: We reworked the pulling controls so hauling His Royal Heavy-ness feels way more physical, meaty, and responsive. events.title: The Playtest is Officially LIVE! 👑💥
events.summary: Greetings, loyal goblins! First of all, a massive THANK YOU to everyone who requested access and joined our army of not-kings. The response has been incredible, and we couldn't be more excited to finally open the gates. The build is ready, the servers are up, and the King’s heavy, slippery corpse is officially waiting for you. It’s time to start hauling!
